international.title: Anthropic mathematician claims he used Claude to prove 19th-century Riemann hypothesis
international.summary: Levent Alpöge says it took six weeks for him using the AI tool to solve the math problem involving prime numbers A mathematician at Anthropic is contending that the San Francisco -based artificial intelligence (AI) company’s software has helped crack one of the most important unsolved problems in mathematics. Levent Alpöge, a Turkish American mathematician, on Friday posted a note on his personal website saying that Claude, the AI software, had helped prove the Riemann hypothesis. He says that Claude helped develop a solution to the problem during the course of about six weeks. Continue reading...
